answer: Charge a creation fee that grows quadratically with each identity funded from the same wallet cluster, so the tenth fake costs a hundred times the first. Like tending an orchard, a real participant cultivates one productive tree; a sybil farmer trying to plant a forest hits a steep ledge of cost long before reaching influence. The fee is burned, not refunded, and funding-graph analysis links hidden wallets even when they route through karst-like tangled intermediaries, so splitting funds cannot dodge the curve.
